title: AnimeSourceIndex
description: What one anime episode actually contains — scenes, visible actions and spoken lines with timestamps. Built from real analysis (scene_detect, frame_sampler, transcriber, agent vision) or explicitly marked as mock. It is the only ground truth an anime_recap_plan may cite.

kind.description: 'analyzed' only when tools really ran on the video file; 'mock' for test or demo data.

tools.description: Tools that produced the data, e.g. scene_detect, frame_sampler, transcriber(large-v3, ja).

transcript_origin.description: faster_whisper = transcriber ran in this build; external_file = a transcriber JSON produced earlier was supplied.

visual_review.description: How many scenes the agent has visually annotated from keyframes (lib/anime_source_indexer.py annotate).

has_subtitles.description: A subtitle stream exists in the container (burned-in text is not detected).

has_audio.description: The file has an audio stream.

visual_summary.description: What is visible on screen (Japanese). Observation only, no interpretation.

reactions.description: Visible reactions (表情・リアクション) observed in the keyframes.

visual_review.description: pending = visual fields not yet filled from keyframes; done = the agent annotated this scene.

speaker.description: character_id, or null when the speaker is not identified.

low_confidence.description: Do not quote until verified: low ASR confidence, a known hallucination, or marked unreliable.

asr_flags.description: Why a line may need checking. clamped_to_scene = ASR times crossed the scene cut and were fitted to it (originals in asr_start/end_seconds); overlaps_previous = starts before the previous line ended (crosstalk or overlapping ASR); invalid_asr_timing = zero-length or inverted ASR times.

asr_start_seconds.description: Original ASR start (ms precision), present when the line was fitted to its scene.

asr_end_seconds.description: Original ASR end (ms precision), present when the line was fitted to its scene.

loudness_db.description: RMS level of the line's audio (dBFS, 16 kHz mono).

excite.description: Heuristic beat-mining signal: loudness above the episode median, exclamations, short lines. Not story understanding.
